Build the full, production-quality landing page in a single pass. It must be complete, runnable, and visually polished on the first attempt. **Output Language:** All code comments and ALL user-facing copy must be written in **English**. --- ## 0. DESIGN BRIEF — THEME DEFINITION **0.1 Concept** A space/cosmic landing page in 2020s contemporary style, inspired by the "three-body problem." The visual metaphor is **gravity and orbits**: a CSS-only orbital system (three glowing celestial bodies on concentric rings), layered cosmic gradients, a subtle drifting starfield, and **glassmorphism** surfaces (translucent panels with `backdrop-filter` blur) floating over the cosmic backdrop. Keywords: gravity, orbits, space, cosmic, glass, translucent, blur. **0.2 Color System (Anchor Palette)** The only permitted anchor hex values are: `#08090f`, `#c9d2e8`, `#e8eefb`, `#67729a`, `#2a3350`, `#5a7ac9`. All other colors must be `rgba()` derivatives of these anchors (for borders, glass tints, shadows) or the success/error tokens defined below. **Light mode is the default/primary theme.** **0.3 Signature Visual Effects (Mandatory)** - **Glass Effect:** translucent surfaces using `backdrop-filter: blur() saturate()` (with `-webkit-` prefix), 1px translucent borders, and an `@supports not (backdrop-filter...)` fallback to a near-opaque tint so text contrast never depends on the blur. - **Cosmic Backdrop:** fixed, full-viewport layer built purely from CSS layered `radial-gradient`s (planet glows, nebula tints in `#5a7ac9`/`#2a3350` alpha) plus a CSS-only starfield (repeating `radial-gradient` dots or multiple `box-shadow` points on a pseudo-element), with an extremely slow drift keyframe animation. - **Orbits:** the hero contains a pure-CSS orbital system — three concentric rings rotating at different speeds (60s/90s/120s linear infinite), each carrying a glowing "body" (radial-gradient circle + `box-shadow` glow), with a central star. - **Hover Effects:** cards lift (`translateY(-2px)` + glow shadow), buttons brighten (`filter: brightness(1.08)`), icons scale subtly. All via CSS transitions and transforms. - **No external images.** Every visual is CSS gradients, box-shadows, transforms, and Material icons. **0.4 Page Sections (Mandatory, in this DOM order)** 1. Hero · 2. Features (3 cards) · 3. How It Works (3 steps) · 4. Testimonials · 5. Pricing (3 tiers) · 6. FAQ · 7. Final CTA · 8. Footer with secondary links. A floating glass **theme-toggle button** (fixed, top-right) is additionally required (see 1.3). --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All styling, layout, and state rules target classes/IDs defined in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain semantic and style-agnostic — restyling the page must never require touching the markup. No inline event handlers (`onclick`, `onsubmit`, etc.); all behavior binds in `script.js`. **1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens** All visual tokens must live in `:root` and theme overrides. Required tokens: - **Colors:** `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, plus `--text-on-primary` (text color paired against `--primary` backgrounds) and `--focus-ring`. - **Baseline mapping (Light — default):** `--bg-primary: #e8eefb` (never pure white; use `#fefefe` only if a near-white surface is genuinely required), `--bg-secondary: #c9d2e8`, `--text-primary: #08090f`, `--text-secondary: #2a3350`, `--primary: #08090f`, `--text-on-primary: #e8eefb`, `--secondary: #5a7ac9`, `--text-success: #0f7a4d`, `--text-error: #c93440`, `--border-default: rgba(8,9,15,0.18)`. - **Baseline mapping (Dark):** `--bg-primary: #08090f`, `--bg-secondary` = a derived deep tint of `#2a3350`, `--text-primary: #e8eefb`, `--text-secondary: #c9d2e8`, `--primary: #e8eefb`, `--text-on-primary: #08090f`, `--secondary: #5a7ac9`, `--text-success: #3ddc97`, `--text-error: #ff6b76`, `--border-default: rgba(201,210,232,0.18)`. - **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforced in **both** themes, not just the default. Body copy may only use `--text-primary`/`--text-secondary`; `--secondary` (`#5a7ac9`) and `#67729a` are reserved for icons, borders, decorative elements, and large text (≥18.66px bold) to preserve AA contrast. - **Glass tokens:** `--glass-bg`, `--glass-border`, `--glass-blur` (e.g., Light: `rgba(232,238,251,0.55)` / `rgba(103,114,154,0.35)` / `16px`; Dark: `rgba(42,51,80,0.35)` / `rgba(201,210,232,0.15)` / `16px`). - **Geometry & Elevation:** `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 16px`, `--radius-lg: 28px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (redefine per theme — dark mode needs stronger/alpha shadows), plus `--shadow-glow: 0 0 48px rgba(90,122,201,0.35)`. - **Spacing & Motion:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--spacing-section: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 7rem)`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`, `--container-max: 1200px`. - **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 1000`, `--z-toast: 2000`; the floating theme toggle uses `--z-dropdown` or higher. - **Fonts:** `--font-display: 'Space Grotesk'`, `--font-base: 'Inter'`. - Set `color-scheme: light` on `:root` and `color-scheme: dark` on the dark theme so native controls and scrollbars adapt. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** - **Exception clause:** The source style spec marks Light mode only — Light remains the default presentation, but Dark Mode is still a mandatory, fully-designed, toggleable companion theme. - **Implementation:** Define dark tokens in a `.dark` class selector **and** duplicate that token block inside `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` under `:root:not(.light)`, so system-dark users get dark on first paint with zero flash, while an explicit class always wins. - **Theme Switching:** Backgrounds, text, borders, glass tints, and shadows must flip purely via CSS variables — no HTML restructuring. - **Persistence:** Store the user's choice in `localStorage` (fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit) and honor live system changes when no explicit choice is stored. The toggle is a visible floating glass button with a Material icon (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`), correct `aria-pressed` state, and a dynamically updated `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"). **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - Build all layout structures with **Flexbox** (`display: flex`). - **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in CSS comments (e.g., pricing feature lists align `flex-start` so check icons align with text; card body copy may align `flex-start` for readability). - **Mobile-First:** Multi-column rows (hero, features, steps, testimonials, pricing) must wrap or re-stack into a single column at your breakpoints (~960px and ~640px). Prevent horizontal scrolling at every viewport width (320px and up) using fluid `clamp()` sizing, wrapping, and `max-width: 100%` on media/visuals — never `overflow-x: hidden` as a crutch. **1.5 CSS Framework Decision (Single Convention)** Use **clean custom CSS with strict BEM naming** (`block__element--modifier`). Do **not** use Tailwind, Bootstrap, or any utility framework — mixing utility classes with BEM is forbidden. All layout and components are hand-authored in `style.css` driven exclusively by the tokens above. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** - **Text:** Load **Space Grotesk** (headings/display) and **Inter** (body) from Google Fonts via `` tags with `preconnect`; bind them to `--font-display` / `--font-base`. - **Icons:** Load **Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** via its Google Fonts stylesheet; render icons as `icon_name` with fixed `width`/`height`/`font-size` to prevent layout shift. **Inline SVGs, emoji icons, and local icon files are forbidden.** Decorative icons get `aria-hidden="true"`; icons conveying state or action get an `aria-label` or visually-hidden text. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--accent`)** All states styled via CSS classes; buttons are flex (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`), min touch target **44×44px**, pill or `--radius-md` geometry. - **Default:** `.btn--primary` = `--primary` bg + `--text-on-primary`; `.btn--secondary` (ghost) = transparent bg + `--border-default` border + `--text-primary`; `.btn--accent` = `--secondary` bg, permitted only with large bold text (AA large-text). - **Hover:** `filter: brightness(1.08)` + `--shadow-md`, `cursor: pointer`. - **Focus:** `:focus-visible` ring using `--focus-ring` (e.g., `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring)` + offset) for keyboard navigation — never remove outlines without replacement. - **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` feedback. - **Loading (`.is-loading` + `aria-busy="true"`):** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks (`pointer-events: none`), renders a CSS `currentColor` border spinner sized `1em` inline — button dimensions must not change. - **Disabled (`[disabled]` / `.is-disabled`):** `opacity: 0.5`, `filter: grayscale(0.6)`, `cursor: not-allowed`, no hover/active transforms. - **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** temporary feedback states colored by `--text-success` / `--text-error` with an accompanying Material icon, announced via an `aria-live` region. **2.2 Card Component (`.card`, `.card--glass`, `.card--featured`)** -
